rachats.citation: In March 2017, Travelers agreed to acquire UK-based Simply Business from Aquiline Capital Partners for approximately $490 million.
On August 15, 2018, Travelers acquired the majority stake of Zensurance, a digital business insurance brokerage in Canada.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
